verdict.rationale: Vanta's own docs describe building private integrations for systems it does not already integrate with, including on-premise and homegrown ones (vanta-docs-52). A documented flow pushes user accounts and custom resources from a homegrown app and turns them into pass/fail evidence via a Custom Test (vanta-docs-2). The API also supports attaching evidence files (vanta-docs-31) and automating evidence collection and testing across system categories (vanta-docs-32), with skill files to help build well-formed integrations (vanta-docs-27). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that private integrations work as described, and detailed endpoint-level reference for the integration and custom-test push endpoints (the evidenced SDKs cover only the Auditor API, and the OpenAPI spec was not found at probed paths).
